t: Founded in 698 by Dae Joyeong, who led Goguryeo refugees and Mohe tribesmen after the fall of Goguryeo.
It ruled Manchuria and northern Korea from Tang-style capitals such as Sanggyeong, modelled on Chang'an.
Conquered by the Khitan in 926, it is claimed in Korean history as the northern partner of Unified Silla.
dyk: The Tang Xuanming calendar, which Japan used for more than 800 years from 862, first reached Japan with an embassy from Balhae.
ev: Dae Joyeong defeats a Tang army at Tianmenling and founds the state of Jin
Tang recognises Dae Joyeong as Commandery Prince of Bohai
The first Balhae embassy reaches Japan
A Balhae fleet raids Dengzhou in Shandong
King Mun moves the court to Sanggyeong, laid out on the plan of Chang'an
King Seon begins a reign of northern expansion
King Dae Inseon surrenders to the Khitan; Balhae becomes the client state of Dongdan

f.capital: Near Mount Dongmo; later the Central Capital, Sanggyeong (Upper Capital) and briefly the Eastern Capital
f.successor: Dongdan (Liao client state); many refugees joined Goryeo
